decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in any wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 6 - The habitable room hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes incidental to the residential use of the single-family dwelling known as 25 Northumberland Avenue, Isleworth. The building shall not be used for any commercial use or as a separate residential unit.

Condition : 7 - 1.	With appropriate safeguarding conditions, the rear extension, because of its design and appearance, is considered acceptable as it relates well to its site and does not harm either the appearance of the surrounding area or the living conditions of neighbours. The development therefore complies with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Residential Extension Guidelines of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
2.	The proposed change of use from garage to habitable room would be compatible with the character and appearance of the property, would not harm the living conditions of the adjoining occupiers, and would comply with the Council's parking standards. The development therefore complies with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations), T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing for Developments) and the Residential Extensions Guidelines.
description: Change of use from garage to habitable room and single storey rear extension to house.
